sources.supports: General SMT recommendation: 2mm holes, 1mm fiducials, 5mm process edges.
Standard requires rails/fiducials; 1mm copper/2mm mask; three or four markers. Rails ship attached by default; removal is requested at order and incurs extra processing fees.
